Use their real marks at balanced optical sizes with generous clear space. A visible pointer selects a client and clicks one clear “Connect Video Use” action. Show a restrained connection line reaching the Video Use hub and the button becoming “Connected”. This is an original illustrative connection diagram, not a fake recording of a provider’s current settings UI. Do not imply partnership, endorsement, universal MCP compatibility or automatic access without account authorization.

During 8–13s, transition to one original chat/workspace panel containing “Make a launch film for Fieldnote.” and three clean original style/reference cards. Move panels on a small set of shared anchors; keep pointer position and click targets synchronized on the same deterministic timeline. During the conceptual app walkthrough, a small readable “Illustrative workflow” label is sufficient. Animate only enough to explain actions; settle readable states before transitions. Build the miniature Fieldnote result with original code/assets, not a static placeholder or a fake generated photoreal clip. Use a restrained original tactile score if helpful; it must remain understandable muted.

Also inspect at960px-wide autoplay size for legibility. Deliver final.mp4, editable scene/source, dependency locks and fresh-machine replay instructions.
